To find the number of students who went out through exit C:

1. Total students = 1000  
2. Students going out through A = 30% of 1000 = $ 0.30 \times 1000 = 300 $  
3. Remaining students after A = $ 1000 - 300 = 700 $  
4. Students going out through B = $ \frac{3}{5} \times 700 = 420 $  
5. Students going out through C = $ 700 - 420 = 280 $

FINAL_ANSWER: 280
